page.layout: One printed page, one text column with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at the top (left and centre). Text runs top to bottom in one column: continuation of a paragraph, heading PETRVS GAVDET., a paragraph, heading IOANNES CORNON., a paragraph. Right margin notes: "Inaudita immanitas" beside the Gaudet paragraph, and "M.D. XXXV." beside the start of the Cornon paragraph. Page number at the top right.

tians. Itaq; Fontenani condemnata vt igni cremaretur, eáque senten-

Petrus Gaudetus è Valligalien si pago, non longè à S. Clodoueo
propè Lutetiam ortus, postquam institutum ordinémque eo-
rum professus esset qui equites Rhodienses appellantur, Geneuam
in ecclesiam Dei cum vxore sua se contulit, anno M.D.XXXIIII. Post
annum circiter dimidium, quidam eius auunculus eques Rhodiensis,
commendator Compesiarum, acerrimus Euangelij inimicus, quum e-
um Gencua dolosè ac fraudulenter euocasset, XXIII. Iunij, pr-
idie eius dici qui S. Ioanni sacer celebratur, comprehendendum curauit per
homines proditores, qui in arce Peneia partes episcopi Geneuensis, ex
ea vrbe tum eiecti, tuebantur. Quum autem ea in arce quinque dies
cum grauissimis tormentis & cruciatibus inclusus fuisset, semper
causam Euangelij fortiter constantérque defendens, postea lento igni
saepius repetito adeò crudeliter vstulatus est, vt ex igni eductus at-que
in eundem reductus ac remissus fuerit. Atque in hoc quidem tam
atroci ac horribili supplicij ac tormenti genere, Deum sine vlla inter-
missione inuocauit, ipsóque secundo die spiritum reddidit, anno M.D.
XXXIIII.
Anno M.D.XXXV. mense Maio, Matiscone Euangelij nomine fuit
captus, atque in carcerem inclusus Ioannes Cornonus, ex ipsa
regione Matisconensi, homo colonus, agris colendis deditus, in ipsa
verbi Dei doctrina valde piè institutus, ac bene exercitatus: quanuis
nullas sciret literas. Quum enim coram iudicibus productus esset, ea
spiritus tum sapientia tum constantia eis respondit, vt confusi & at-
toniti huiusmodi poenam in eum constituerint, vt viuus comburere-
tur. A qua sententia is nullo modo vnquam prouocare voluit. Itaque
tractus crate ad vltimum supplicium, insigne morte sua testimonium
veritati dedit, ad finem mensis Iunij, anni M.D.XXXV.

page.notes: The first letter of "Anno" and of "Petrus" is a decorative woodcut initial; it is joined to the word as the first letter. The initial of "Anno" reads as a decorated A and is transcribed as such. The running head is read as "Gaudet,& Cornon." and "LIBER II." The woodcut initial in the Gaudet paragraph is partly obscured by the scan and read from context. Some letters in the Cornon paragraph ("Matiscone") contain a doubtful final letter, marked by the scan quality but read as printed.
